# Finatix

> Independent online CIMA study platform. Free Certificate courses (BA1–BA4), with exam-style question banks currently available for BA1 and BA2. Higher-level courses are being written and are not yet on sale.

Finatix offers exam-style practice with instant marking and progress tracking. It is not accredited by or affiliated with CIMA or AICPA & CIMA.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview and CIMA training intro.
- [Why CIMA](/why-cima): Career value and benefits of the CIMA qualification.
- [Courses](/courses): Full directory of CIMA papers (BA1–BA4, E1–E3, P1–P3, F1–F3, OCS, MCS, SCS).
- [Pricing](/pricing): Prices for courses, bundles and membership.
- [About](/about): Mission, team and approach.
- [Contact](/contact): Support, sales and FAQ.
- [Help Centre](/help): Common questions and platform guides.
- [Start here](/start): Choose a starting point.
